# Father Figure Nutrition

> Veteran-owned supplement brand built for hardworking men.

Father Figure Nutrition is a veteran-owned supplement brand delivering clean, effective nutrition for men who lead. Our products are formulated with organic ingredients, zero fillers, and real results in mind — from strength and recovery to daily wellness and digestive health.

## Products
- [Creatine Hardbody](https://fatherfigurenutrition.com/product/creatine-hardbody): Micronized creatine monohydrate gummies, 5g per serving, 30 servings. Built for strength, power, and recovery.
- [Multi Vitamin Plus](https://fatherfigurenutrition.com/product/multi-vitamin-plus): Daily multivitamin with 23 essential vitamins and minerals, 80% organic, zero fillers.
- [15 Day Fresh Start Cleanse](https://fatherfigurenutrition.com/product/15-day-fresh-start-cleanse): Gentle 15-day digestive reset formulated with organic herbs and fiber.
